batch.description: HSTU admission paper, academic session 2016-2017, transcribed 2026-10-31 by direct visual reading of the HSTU section (printed book pp.273-279) of the Udvash 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক' compilation scan (TargetPDF/CamScanner). The source prints NO unit label and NO set/shift label anywhere, so the paper is recorded with unit 'unassigned'; unit identification by question-level matching against Satt Academy's per-unit 2016-17 banks is a separate later stage. 100 questions: Physics 25 + Chemistry 25 + Biology 25 + English 25, each subject numbered 1-25 independently, with Physics/Chemistry/Biology split across printed Short/Extra/Old syllabus-tier boxes that partition 1-25 exactly once (merged here by printed number). Answers are inline in the source ([Ans: x] tags and/or worked solutions headed 'সমাধান: (x)'); there is no separate answer table. The scan's right edge crops the [Ans:] column: 17 questions' keys are not recoverable from this source and are encoded unknown (Biology Extra 01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 10, 11; English 01-07, 09, 10; Chemistry Extra 21), and several further tags are partially cropped but legible (noted per question). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions content-UNVERIFIED, all recorded keys answer-UNVERIFIED. Bengali numerals converted to Western digits and mathematics linearised (fractions as a/b, powers as ^) per project convention; original wording, option order, numbering and original errors preserved. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 26 of 100 questions verified. Unit identified as A by question-level content matching against Satt Academy's per-unit banks (all 60 public Unit A cards pair with this paper; no other unit matches) — see VERIFICATION.md. row 3: excluded (DIFFER) row 4: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 5: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 6: excluded (DIFFER) row 7: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 9: excluded (DIFFER) row 12: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 14: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 15: excluded (DIFFER) row 16: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 17: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 18: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 20: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 21: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 23: excluded (DIFFER) row 25: excluded (DIFFER) row 26: excluded (DIFFER) row 29: excluded (DIFFER) row 30: excluded (DIFFER) row 31: excluded (DIFFER) row 32: excluded (DIFFER) row 34: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 35: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (DIFFER) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 43: excluded (DIFFER) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (DIFFER) row 46: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 48: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 49: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 50: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: key taken from Satt (d) - sourceDocuments.title: Udvash GST cluster question bank — HSTU questions & solutions 2016-17 section (TargetPDF scan)
sourceDocuments.notes: 7-page excerpt (printed book pp.273-279) of the Udvash-branded book 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক', scanned via CamScanner and circulated through the 'Target PDF' Telegram channel (watermarks on every page). Running header: 'HSTU প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭'. Paper header (PDF p.1): 'HSTU ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ', পূর্ণমান: ১০০, MCQ, সময়: ১ ঘণ্টা ৩০ মিনিট. No unit label and no set/shift label is printed anywhere in the 7 pages. Answers are inline only ([Ans: x] tags and/or 'সমাধান: (x)' worked solutions); the scan's right edge crops the [Ans:] tag column on several pages (worst on PDF p.6). Because the print origin is Udvash, this compilation must not be used as the independent source for anything itself transcribed from an Udvash publication.
